question.en: Discuss the significance of structural transformation in the Indian economy, highlighting the shift from the primary to the tertiary sector.
question.hi: Discuss the significance of structural transformation in the Indian economy, highlighting the shift from the primary to the tertiary sector.

modelAnswer.en: Structural transformation involves the reallocation of labor and capital from low-productivity sectors (Primary) to high-productivity sectors (Secondary/Tertiary). In India, this shift has been unique as the economy moved directly from Primary to Tertiary, bypassing a robust manufacturing-led growth phase. This has implications for employment quality and sustainable development.
